mentions.h: SOUTH OF THE THAMES "JUNIOR" REIGATE PRIORY. NOV.9TH

mentions.note: set record of 6 miles 947 yards with Brian Nott; now Secretary of the Reebok Surrey Cross Country League; won 1957 with B.Nott and 1958 with brother David

share.d: Bill Bird (Ranelagh) in The Belgravian, the Belgrave Harriers club gazette, 1997: 2 mentions in 2 issues.
